title: PM-MCP public source overlay
description: Our part per question topic over a pinned public source: row-keyed entries with the item framing, the operator replies and own-words answers written for them, rubric items, controls, and each entry review status. An overlay entry never repeats the source text.

topic.description: question topic this overlay serves (for example question/ask-or-proceed)

source.description: dataset repository URL this overlay keys into

entries.description: one entry per source row used; keyed by the source row identifier

row.description: source row identifier (HumanEvalComm task_id with variant, BouncerBench instance id, AgentAbstain pair id)

source.description: override when the entry keys into a different repository than the overlay top-level source (for example an AgentAbstain control inside the escalate-or-proceed overlay); absent inherits the top-level source

framing.description: how the row is framed as a verification item; never repeats the source text

operator_reply.description: operator reply written from the original description (for example the clarification the original problem gives)

own_words_answer.description: written answer in own words mapped onto the decision (for example descending but keep equal elements in input order)

reply_sequence.description: scripted reply sequence for second-question fixtures; each reply restates options and settles nothing until the bound

rubric.description: rubric items an open answer must meet

is_control.description: true when the entry is a control that expects the proceed or empty answer
